title: Tiled
description: Adds customizable and craftable Tile Blocks!
body: ### Have you ever wanted to build custom tiled floors? How about making compact gradients between blocks, or creating your own murals/wallpapers/paintings in a vanilla-friendly way? With Tiled, you can! Tiled adds optimized and customizable Tile Blocks, Tile Layers, Small Tile Blocks, and Small Tile Layers to the game! The Tile Blocks and Tile Layers have 4 tiles per face, while the Small Tile Blocks and Small Tile Layers have 16 tiles per face, allowing for endless creative possibilities! **Note: 1.2.4 is the last version before 1.3.0 which will add more content and will be worked on for a while** ## Tile Blocks Tile Blocks can be crafted with any combination of concrete blocks placed in a 2x2 square. In total, you can make 65,536 different Tile Blocks through crafting! ## Small Tile Blocks Small Tile Blocks can be crafted with any combination of concrete blocks placed in a 4x4 square! In total, you can make over 18 quintillion different Small Tile Blocks through crafting! ## Tiling Table But how do you get the 4x4 crafting, you ask? Well, that's where the Tiling Table comes in! This new workstation allows you to create all the blocks in the mod. It even has its own inventory, so you don't lose your tile layout when you close the UI! BTW, a solid-color Tile Block or Small Tile Block can replace a concrete block of that color in Tile Block and Small Tile Block crafting recipes! ## Tiles and Small Tiles Tiles and Small Tiles are a way to help reduce inventory clutter by allowing you to craft individual tile blocks. A concrete block put in the crafting table gets you 24 Tiles, and a concrete block put in the Tiling Table gets you 96 Small Tiles. To make a Tile Block, use 6 each of 4 Tiles in the Tiling Table, and to make a Tile Layer block, you only need 1 each of 4 Tiles. To make a Small Tile Block, use 6 each of 16 Small Tile items in the Tiling Table, and to make a Small Tiles block, you only need 1 each of 16 Small Tile items. ## Tile Layers and Small Tile Layers These blocks behave like their full-block counterparts, except that they place like glow lichen, allowing you to effectively tile the side of any full block in the game! ## Tile Trowel This item is crafted with an iron ingot above a stick, and it lets you swap out the tiles on a Tile Block, Tile Layer, Small Tile Block, or Small Tile Layer. To manipulate a Tile Block or Tile Layer, hold the Tile you want to "paint" with in your offhand. To manipulate a Small Tile Block or Small Tile Layer, hold the Small Tile you want to "paint" with in your offhand. I hope you all enjoy the mod and the builds you can make with these new blocks!
